facts.fact: The Somali National Bureau of Statistics (SNBS) states that data and datasets are published on its Open Data Portal, free of charge and available in human- and machine-readable formats; no dataset count is given. The date is the document's published date.

SNBS states that all data and datasets published on its Open Data Portal are provided under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC-BY 4.0), allowing users to download, copy, redistribute and make derivative works with attribution. The date is the document's published date.
